defects.description: Stats row text is extremely small and nearly illegible, lacking clear labels for the numbers
The stats row is cramped and lacks adequate padding from the name/title above it
The card container is very plain, missing subtle shadows or borders that would give it depth

missing_elements: Clear labels for stats (Followers, Following, Posts) are missing or too small to read
Job title 'Product Designer' is present but poorly styled/weighted
top_fixes: Increase font size of the stats row significantly and add clear labels (Followers, Following, Posts)
Improve vertical spacing between the job title and the stats row
Establish a clearer typographic hierarchy: make the name bolder/larger and the job title a distinct secondary style

manifest.prompt: Create a user profile card: a circular avatar placeholder, the name 'Maya Chen', the job title 'Product Designer', and a row of three stats - 128 Followers, 342 Following, 56 Posts.
